qualifications.subject: Stesky access and possible recurrence
qualifications.finding: MASK names a missing neroid pet through an unnamed consultation client; Vanir gives that client location advice, without a shown retrieval. MAIN16 names an escaped hell-neroid through Amaryllis and an unanswered location request. Same spelling is a possible identity edge only: no explicit shared owner/event/species-subtype join, recovery or proven relation to the killed pursuer. Neither declare two certified individuals nor silently merge them.

qualifications.subject: Vampire continuity and retirement
qualifications.finding: MAIN17 explicitly recalls the same earlier Vanir trip/true-ancestor room and shows Kazuma using the destination with the Demon King. The owner is offstage; there is no performed tomato farming, relocation, death or continued residence. Place continuity is not a new owner action.

qualifications.subject: Owner exclusions
qualifications.finding: Wolfgang Crow selfnames, is described by Aqua as not a true ancestor, vows changed conduct and is actually purified311. No fulfilled reformation or route to MAIN16 is established. The YORI03 owner is explicitly a female succubus, distinct from this vampire. Older ambiguous possible-join wording is preserved as history, not active evidence.

qualifications.subject: Typed unrelated references
qualifications.finding: Lich comparison, hypothetical commander categories, genre analogy, Sylvia exclusion, relative undead-rank report, remembered Japanese analogy, uninstantiated vampire preference and a suspected former room owner are separate access types. None identifies the MAIN16 owner.

qualifications.subject: Author paratext
qualifications.finding: Complete30P afterword is author paratext and mentions a vampire in Kemono Michi. It supplies no KonoSuba canonical vampire individual. Adaptive preparation deliberately left access pending; classify after actual reading. Four complete current narrative members and one complete paratext member remain separate.

qualifications.subject: Gil literal false positives
qualifications.finding: Remaining non-guild substrings are the Egil tree and a dragon roar. Neither is the named Gil. The lexical filter supplies no exhaustive absence, image admission or global unique-person count.

qualifications.finding: Demon King rejection of bait, escape preparation, attack, injury, daughter-made handkerchief report and eventual charge are now known. Multiple triggers co-occur at110; no causal isolation of daughter gift versus repeated insults. Daughter is not directly onstage. No later C49 source holdout can erase this exposure.

qualifications.subject: Anna unchanged
qualifications.finding: The existing Anna study already correctly preserves the mediated request, actual storytelling and missed coach atU013P4. This current return adds no new interpretation requiring a source supplement or second study.

qualifications.subject: Dungeon treasure wording and ownership limits
qualifications.finding: Kazuma calls the taking robbery. The vampire says dungeons exist to be entered and identifies the stored treasure/equipment as adventurers possessions. This does not individually trace prior ownership or establish a universal entitlement rule. Preserve his account and the visible pressure rather than converting the line into a complete ownership code.
